Key Features & Advantages

Automatic Locking Mechanism

Positive-grip cam lock automatically clamps firmly onto the drum rim as tension is applied.

Grade 80 Chain Integration

Clamps firmly onto 2-leg Grade 80 alloy steel chain slings for crane or forklift suspension.

Lightweight & Quick Operation

Compact design enables quick one-man attachment and release without manual pin locking.

Standards & Compliance

EN 13155

Non-fixed load lifting attachments compliance.

CE Certified

Manufactured under strict ISO 9001 European safety standards.

Product Overview

The Europull EPSL series drum lifter is specifically designed for the secure lifting and transfer of standard 55-gallon steel drums in chemical processing plants, refineries, marine vessels, and offshore oilfield platforms.

Frequently Asked Questions

Which models of the Europull Drum Lifter are available?

The Europull Drum Lifter is available in 2 models: EPSL-500, EPSL-1000. Capacity (kg) ranges from 500 kg to 1,000 kg. Full figures for every model are in the technical specifications table on this page.

What capacity range does the Europull Drum Lifter cover?

The Europull Drum Lifter covers 500kg - 1000kg.

Which standard does the Europull Drum Lifter comply with?

The Europull Drum Lifter is manufactured to EN 13155.

What drum Compatibility does the Europull Drum Lifter have?

The Europull Drum Lifter's drum Compatibility: Standard 55-Gallon (210 Liter) Steel & Rimmed Drums.

What locking Mechanism does the Europull Drum Lifter have?

The Europull Drum Lifter's locking Mechanism: Automatic Positive Gravity Cam Locking.

What chain Attachment does the Europull Drum Lifter have?

The Europull Drum Lifter's chain Attachment: Fitted to 2-Leg Grade 80 Lifting Chain Assembly.
